text: Meet Constra. The app that runs your crew, right from your phone.
Open it, and your whole day is right there. Who's on site, the hours this week, and anything that needs your attention.
Your crew clocks in with one tap. A photo, and a G P S location, so you always know who's really on the job.
Then Friday comes, and the timesheets are already done. Pick your dates, and download a P D F or an Excel file, with overtime worked out for you.
Plan the crew's week. Put people on jobs, and tap send. Everyone gets their job, their start time, and the address.
Send invoices, and see at a glance who has paid, and who is overdue.
Every project shows its progress, its budget, and its tasks.
Daily reports and safety logs take seconds, and they're saved with the job.
There are even twenty-three ready-made Excel templates, with your own logo on top.
And when you want an answer, just ask. Which jobs are losing money? Which invoices haven't been paid? The A I assistant looks at your numbers, and tells you.
It keeps working when the signal drops, too. Everything saves on the phone, and syncs when you're back online.
Constra. Free while it's launching. Run the job, not the paperwork.
